input_audit.contract: Same physical machine, weight addresses, work and mathematical data/control edges; only Up task tiles change. Cold nonlocal matches per-cluster Up work but does not freeze dynamic arbitration or input path length. Warm preload moves actual Up storage to its consumer, retains the full L0 catalog/order and pays finite per-cluster capacity; subsequent traffic may differ.
